goal: Document the SPADE-on-CosyVoice2 reproduction process in CosyVoice2.md and provide beginner-friendly one-command scripts so anyone can reproduce from zero.

requirement_alignment.source: User request: '把目前在CosyVoice2上复现的过程记录在CosyVoice2.md，并保留必要的脚本，保证小白能从零复现'
requirement_alignment.goal: A beginner can clone the repo and reproduce the CosyVoice2 SPADE experiment with documented commands and scripts, without editing code or config paths.
non_goals: Re-running the full 2-hour experiment as part of validation (FAST smoke mode used instead)
user_visible_behavior: CosyVoice2.md: step-by-step Chinese guide (env, data, WLI, prune, distill, averaging, eval, artifacts, FAQ, knobs)
scripts/reproduce_cosyvoice2.sh: one-command driver with FAST smoke mode and env knobs
scripts/download_cosyvoice2_data.sh: resumable data download honoring proxy env
Config defaults auto-resolve data paths (no editing needed)
constraints: Documentation must match the actual verified commands
Scripts must be idempotent (skip existing downloads/checkpoints)
risks: Hardcoded absolute paths in docs/scripts would break fresh machines (addressed with COSYVOICE_ROOT defaults + smart data-path defaults)
acceptance_checks: FAST mode runs all 6 stages end-to-end (verified: EXIT=0, summary printed)
CosyVoice2.md documents every stage with exact commands
requirement_alignment.validation_approach: FAST smoke run of the driver script + pytest + shell syntax checks
requirement_alignment.first_iteration_scope: CosyVoice2.md + scripts + config path defaults + README link
assumptions: The FAST smoke run (300 utts, 1 epoch) is sufficient to validate the driver; the full run was already validated in the merged scale-data PR

issues.title: docs[cv2-8]: CosyVoice2.md reproduction guide + one-command scripts
acceptance_checks: CosyVoice2.md: step-by-step Chinese guide (env, data, WLI, prune, distill, averaging, eval, FAQ, artifacts)
scripts/reproduce_cosyvoice2.sh: one-command driver (with FAST smoke mode + env knobs)
config defaults resolve paths automatically; existing pytest suite passes
FAST mode verified end-to-end (all 6 stages complete)

rounds.test_summary: 45 tests pass; bash -n clean; FAST driver run end-to-end (setup->data->WLI->prune->distill->average->eval, EXIT=0) with SPADE_FAST=1
rounds.implementation_summary: Added CosyVoice2.md (Chinese step-by-step guide), scripts/reproduce_cosyvoice2.sh (one-command driver with FAST mode and env knobs), scripts/download_cosyvoice2_data.sh (resumable parquet download); data_prep auto-resolves standard data paths; README links the guide.
